app_info.subtitle: Generate AI thumbnails
app_info.description: ViewBAIT helps creators check account credits and plan limits, browse projects and generation assets, generate and edit YouTube-style thumbnails with their account credits, and compare thumbnail options with creative scores and next-step guidance.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the authenticated profile, subscription credits, and plan generation limits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems; it only queries the user's private ViewBAIT account data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists owned and shared ViewBAIT projects without changing project data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only against the user's private ViewBAIT workspace records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a project, its saved defaults, thumbnail count, and recent thumbnails.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or mutate external systems; it reads private project and thumbnail records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new private ViewBAIT project and may store optional generation defaults.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the authenticated user's private ViewBAIT database, not public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new project records and does not delete or irreversibly overwrite existing projects.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates an owned project's name and/or saved generation defaults.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes remain inside the user's private ViewBAIT workspace and are not published externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs bounded owned-project metadata updates and does not delete projects or revoke access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists available styles, palettes, and saved face references for generation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists owned thumbnails with optional project and favorite filters.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private thumbnail records and does not publish or mutate external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates new thumbnail assets, uploads them to storage, and deducts account credits through the generation pipeline.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls external image-generation providers and stores resulting images for the authenticated user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new thumbnail versions and cleans up failed inserts; it does not delete existing successful thumbnails or revoke access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new edited thumbnail version from an owned original and deducts account credits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends the edit request to external image-generation providers and stores the new image for the user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Leaves the original thumbnail intact and creates a new version instead of deleting or overwriting the source.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads owned thumbnails and returns a creative comparison without modifying thumbnail or project records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends thumbnail images to an external multimodal model to produce comparison scores and recommendations.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Check account plan, credits, and generation limits before creating thumbnails.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is my ViewBAIT plan, how many credits do I have left, and what resolutions can I generate?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns account identity, credit balance, plan name, and allowed generation capabilities such as resolutions and max variations.

test_cases.description: Browse available projects and open one workspace for recent thumbnails.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my ViewBAIT projects, then open the most recently updated one and show its recent thumbnails.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists accessible projects, then returns the selected project's defaults, thumbnail count, and recent thumbnail details.

test_cases.description: Generate a new set of thumbnail options for a video title.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate 2 ViewBAIT thumbnails for a video titled "I Tried Building a Tiny House" in 16:9 at 1K with bold readable text.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates up to two thumbnail results with image URLs, success status, and updated credit usage information.

test_cases.description: Edit an existing owned thumbnail with a focused change request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Take my latest ViewBAIT thumbnail and edit it to make the face more surprised and increase text contrast for mobile.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds an owned thumbnail, creates a new edited version with a new image URL, and reports credits used and remaining.

test_cases.description: Compare multiple thumbnail candidates and recommend a winner.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare my two most recent ViewBAIT thumbnails and tell me which is more likely to earn a click on mobile, with concrete next steps.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a winner thumbnail id, rationale, per-candidate creative scores, and recommended next steps without claiming measured CTR.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar scheduling requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow and can you reschedule my 3pm?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar access is outside ViewBAIT's thumbnail workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for outbound email or messaging requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email my collaborators the latest marketing brief and ping them on Slack.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because sending email or chat messages is outside its supported tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for YouTube upload or analytics requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Upload this video to YouTube and show me last week's channel CTR analytics.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because publishing videos and reading YouTube analytics are outside ViewBAIT MCP capabilities.
